manual.metal_press.line2: {0}The Metal Press is an automated way of shaping metal. It uses a high pressure piston to press plates, rods, or other metal components using molds.{1}
manual.metal_press.line3: The machine is created as shown above by using an Engineer's Hammer on the piston.{0}
manual.metal_press.line4: Power is input through the plug on the top of the piston, and items through the conveyors in the direction of movement.{0}
manual.metal_press.line5: The lower middle block is the redstone control port, rightclicking it with an Engineer's Screwdriver allows you to invert the redstone control.{0}
manual.metal_press.line6: {0}To actually work, the metal press requires a mold to be attached to the piston. These molds are created in the {1}§o§nEngineer's §o§nWorkbench§r{2} using the blueprint displayed above.{3}
manual.metal_press.line7: {0}Molds are crafted as shown above, with the wirecutter taking some damage for every crafting operation. They are then inserted into the metal press by right-clicking the multiblock with a mold in hand.{1}
manual.metal_press.line8: {0}The packing and unpacking molds can be used to compress 4 or 9 of the same item into their relevant storage form, as well as unpack them again. This can be utilized to store ingots as blocks, or automatically create simple blocks like Sandstone.
